name: Onna Kentoushi ~Chijoku no Tougijou~
original_name: 女剣闘士　～恥辱の闘技場～
source:
A violation ADV novel + prepare-for-battle SLG
Women sold into slavery have one way to win their freedom.
Cultivate their skills and enjoy the epic sex!

The player can choose 3 unique heroines:
a circus announcer, a warrioress, and a proud noble.
They each have suffered terrible fates, and must fight to live.
Nothing can be worse than this slavery... can it?

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ161921.html/]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
一款融合凌辱题材文字冒险与战前培养模拟玩法的游戏。
被卖为奴隶的女性，只有一条重获自由的道路。
培养她们的能力，体验激烈的性爱！

玩家可以选择三位各具特色的女主角：
马戏团报幕员、女战士，以及高傲的贵族。
她们都遭遇了悲惨的命运，必须为活下去而战。
总不会有什么比这奴隶生活更糟了吧…真的不会吗？

[摘自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ161921.html/]DLsite英文版[/url]]
